segments.ja447:1.1: Kiṃ te vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ, kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko;
segments.ja447:1.3: Akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etamatthaṃ, kasmā nu tumhaṃ daharā na miyyare [mīyare (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja447:2.1: Dhammaṃ carāma na musā bhaṇāma, pāpāni kammāni parivajjayāma [vivajjayāma (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja447:2.3: Anariyaṃ parivajjemu sabbaṃ, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:3.1: Suṇoma dhammaṃ asataṃ satañca, na cāpi dhammaṃ asataṃ rocayāma;
segments.ja447:3.3: Hitvā asante na jahāma sante, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:4.1: Pubbeva dānā sumanā bhavāma, dadampi ve attamanā bhavāma;
segments.ja447:4.3: Datvāpi ve nānutappāma pacchā, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:5.1: Samaṇe mayaṃ brāhmaṇe addhike ca, vanibbake yācanake dalidde;
segments.ja447:5.3: Annena pānena abhitappayāma, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:6.1: Mayañca bhariyaṃ nātikkamāma, amhe ca bhariyā nātikkamanti;
segments.ja447:6.3: Aññatra tāhi brahmacariyaṃ carāma, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:7.1: Pāṇātipātā viramāma sabbe, loke adinnaṃ parivajjayāma;
segments.ja447:7.3: Amajjapā nopi musā bhaṇāma, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:8.1: Etāsu ve jāyare suttamāsu, medhāvino honti pahūtapaññā;
segments.ja447:8.3: Bahussutā vedaguno [vedaguṇā (syā. ka.)] ca honti, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:9.1: Mātā pitā ca [mātā ca pitā (ka.), mātāpitarā (syā.)] bhaginī bhātaro ca, puttā ca dārā ca mayañca sabbe;
segments.ja447:9.3: Dhammaṃ carāma paralokahetu, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:10.1: Dāsā ca dāsyo [dāsso (sī. pī.), dāsī (syā.)] anujīvino ca, paricārakā kammakarā ca sabbe;
segments.ja447:10.3: Dhammaṃ caranti paralokahetu, tasmā hi amhaṃ daharā na miyyare.
segments.ja447:11.1: Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahāti;
segments.ja447:11.3: Esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
segments.ja447:12.1: Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, chattaṃ mahantaṃ viya vassakāle;
segments.ja447:12.3: Dhammena gutto mama dhammapālo, aññassa aṭṭhīni sukhī kumāroti.
